nodes.evidence: Harness frame LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput at fuzzer-api.cpp:94 is present in the crash stack (frame 17). The crash occurs deep inside TessBaseAPI::GetUTF8Text (frame 16), which OCRs the Pix produced by createPix; the crash therefore proves createPix ran and produced the OCR'd image. Exact line-80 coverage would need an --coverage rebuild (deferred), but node reachability is witnessed by the crash path.

Crash-stack frame 7 is RecognizeLine at lstmrecognizer.cpp:308 (network_->Forward). PreparePixInput at line 307 executes immediately before line 308 in the same block, so the int8 input tensor `inputs` was materialized on the crashing path. The taint value-flow into the sink is a DFSan claim (deferred).

Exactly crash-stack frame 7 (lstmrecognizer.cpp:308, network_->Forward). The Pix has been admitted through GetUTF8Text -> recog_all_words -> classify_word_pass1 -> LSTMRecognizeWord and enters the LSTM network forward pass.

Source verified verbatim: line 138 is `temp_lines[i].Init(no_, ro, scratch);` (undersizes the SIMD output scratch buffer to no_ while capacity is ro=RoundOutputs(no_)). The patch (91b2b4f4) changes ONLY this call to `temp_lines[i].Init(ro, scratch);`. Patch differential: same PoC crashes on n132/arvo:32142-vul and exits 0 on n132/arvo:32142-fix, confirming this sizing site is the root cause. The enclosing function FullyConnected::Forward is also on the crash stack (frame 5, fullyconnected.cpp:153).

ASan allocation stack frame 7: FloatVec::Init at networkscratch.h:147 (`vec_->reserve(reserve)`), called from LSTM::Forward at lstm.cpp:289 (alloc frame 8). This is the reserved-but-pooled backing store of the overflowed 4096-byte region [0x62100000b500,0x62100000c500). The size() container annotation that makes the write OOB is set one line later at networkscratch.h:148 (`vec_->resize(size)`, size==no_) via the FullyConnected root-cause Init.
Crash-stack frame 4 (fullyconnected.cpp:221). Hands the undersized temp_line to weights_.MatrixDotVector.

Crash-stack frame 3 (weightmatrix.cpp:296). Indirect dispatch to IntSimdMatrix::intSimdMatrix->matrixDotVectorFunction (the AVX2 kernel) with v = the undersized output buffer. The AVX2 path being taken (control condition IntSimdMatrix::intSimdMatrix != null) is witnessed by the crash landing inside intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp.

Exactly crash-stack frame 0. Source line 136 is `_mm256_storeu_pd(v + 12, res4567);` (32-byte AVX2 store). ASan: container-overflow WRITE of size 32 at 0x62100000b87f, SUMMARY intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp:136:3 in tesseract::ExtractResults16. Reproduced deterministically on n132/arvo:32142-vul (2/2 runs, identical crash address).

root_cause_criterion.condition: temp_lines[i].Init(ro, scratch)  // size the SIMD output scratch buffer to ro=RoundOutputs(no_)=Roundup(no_,8), not to no_
root_cause_criterion.evidence: Vulnerable code at fullyconnected.cpp:138 sizes the buffer to no_ (Init(no_, ro, scratch)) while the AVX2 kernel writes ro doubles; when no_ % 8 != 0 the tail [no_, ro) is written out-of-container. Patch differential over the identical PoC: n132/arvo:32142-vul -> container-overflow WRITE size 32 at intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp:136; n132/arvo:32142-fix (Init(ro, scratch)) -> exit 0, clean. root_cause_confirmed = vul_crashes && fix_clean = true.
